title: File:Nintendo-Super-NES-Console-BR.jpg
desc: The Super Nintendo Entertainment System (also known as the Super NES & SNES), a fourth generation video game console released by Nintendo in North America in 1991.  The successor to the NES, this 16-bit console went on to become the highest-selling console of its generation.
